answer: An agent marketplace requires one unit of escrowed stake for each order slot, whether agents trade violet dye, umber pigment, or summit maps. Stake stays locked for 30 days after a slot closes, and splitting it among identities creates no extra slots. A sybil attacker seeking 10,000 simultaneous orders must therefore lock 10,000 units of capital; generating free identities cannot evade this linear cost or the delay before funds can be reused.
